content:
Both incidents involved the same edge‑gateway pod – **edge‑gateway‑03**.

* July 2025 (INC‑0060) – the 504 s were traced to the node running **edge‑gateway‑03**【INC-0060#0】【INC-0060#1】【INC-0060#2】.  
* January 2026 (INC‑0119) – the node under **edge‑gateway‑03** was under resource pressure, causing the pod to be slow【INC-0119#0】【INC-0119#1】【INC-0119#2】.  

Thus, the same pod (edge‑gateway‑03) experienced node‑related slowness in both incidents.
